test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six professional interior designers, Pavan, Nayan, Ratan, Shiva, Tanuja and Urmila, are sitting around a hexagonal table, each at one corner, and are facing the centre of the hexagonal table. Pavan is second to the left of Urmila. Nayan is the neighbour of Ratan and Shiva. Tanuja is second to the left of Shiva. Who among the following are the neighbours of Pavan?
solution: Six professional interior designers, Pavan, Nayan, Ratan, Shiva, Tanuja and Urmila, are sitting around a hexagonal table, each at one corner, and are facing the centre of the hexagonal table. 1) Tanuja is second to the left of Shiva and Nayan is the neighbour of Ratan and Shiva.
